load_retriever_model: load a Contriever retriever model and tokenizer from a local checkpoint path or HuggingFace model ID
create_Contriever_embeddings: create dense text embeddings using the Contriever class with average or cls pooling strategies
create_XLMRetriever_embeddings: create multilingual dense text embeddings using the XLMRetriever class based on XLM-RoBERTa
create_ALBERTRetriever_embeddings: create dense text embeddings using the ALBERTRetriever class based on ALBERT with configurable pooling
create_T5Contriever_embeddings: create dense text embeddings using the T5Contriever class based on T5 encoder with normalization
